description: Find emails, phone numbers, IBANs, card numbers, tokens, IP addresses, passwords and faces (on-device) and cover them in one undo step, in the user’s Redaction style (noise by default). style overrides it: noise fills the area with opaque random colors from it, blur pixelates with blocks sized to the text, solid covers it with a plain box. pixelSize sets the noise block size or a coarser minimum for blur. Defaults to every image and category. Returns the ids and counts.

pixelSize.description: Noise block size, or minimum blur block size, in canvas units.

style.description: noise, blur or solid. Defaults to the user’s Redaction setting.

tabId.description: Target tab id. Defaults to the active tab.

name: snipaya_redact
title: Redact sensitive data
